Structural Designer (TEKLA) Introduction 
As a Structural Designer, you'll transform engineering concepts into accurate 3D models and detailed production drawings. Function 
 - Develop detailed 3D models, General Arrangement, fabrication and assembly drawings for offshore structures; - Translate engineering calculations and concepts into practical, buildable designs; - Model structural steel, appurtenances and temporary structures such as grillage, seafastening and lifting arrangements; - Support engineers with technical detailing and coordinate models and drawings across multiple engineering disciplines; - Prepare drawing packages for fabrication and construction; - Ensure all models and drawings comply with project requirements, offshore standards and Enersea's quality procedures. Requirements 
You enjoy turning engineering ideas into practical designs and have an eye for detail without losing sight of the bigger picture. - HBO degree or MBO+ education in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering or a comparable technical discipline; - Experience as a Structural Designer within the offshore, maritime or heavy industry sector; - Good knowledge of structural steel detailing and fabrication methods, with experience in Tekla Structures and/or AutoCAD (SolidWorks is an advantage); - Strong communication skills in English; Dutch language skills or willingness to learn Dutch; - A proactive attitude, attention to detail and the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team.

Car Mover

What are you going to do?
There’s no sitting around here! As a car mover, you’ll make sure brand-new cars end up in the right place. You’ll drive the latest models and play a key role in the logistics process.

What will you be doing?

Safely and carefully move and park new cars on the premises.

Load and unload trains and ships using the very latest vehicles.

Help colleagues by giving clear instructions when parking and moving cars.

In short: a varied job where you’re on the move all day and surrounded by the latest cars.

What do we offer?
- Hourly wage of €14.99 to €16.23, excluding ADV
- Shift differential of 33% to 125%
- 25 vacation days (full-time)
- €0.23 per km travel allowance
- Flexible working hours

Where will you work?
At CLDN in Ritthem, you’ll join a friendly and down-to-earth team where everyone helps each other out. Whether you have a lot of experience or are just starting out, you’ll receive thorough training and quickly become part of the group.

The best part? You’ll drive brand-new cars all day long, and you get to decide for the most part when you work. It’s ideal if you want to balance your job with school, hobbies, sports, or your family.

Do you love cars, enjoy being on the go, and are you looking for flexible work? Then CLDN is the perfect place for you.

What do we ask?
Would you like to work as a car transporter? If so, here’s what we’re looking for:

- 18 years of age or older
- Fluent in Dutch or English
- Must have held a Class B (European) driver’s license for at least 1 year
- Own transportation
- No problem applying for a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG)
- Available to work between 8 and 40 hours per week
- Flexibility

Are you interested?
Do you have any questions about the position? Feel free to contact Marleen at 06 14 93 73 82 or Gadicha at 06 51 13 75 76. You can call us or send us a WhatsApp message. We’d be happy to help!

Then this opportunity as a High-Tech Logistics Operator could be the perfect fit for you. As part of an international organization, you will play an important role in ensuring that materials and products move efficiently throughout the production process. Your contribution helps keep operations running smoothly and supports the delivery of high-quality products worldwide. What’s your job about? As a High-Tech Logistics Operator, you are responsible for supporting the daily logistics activities within the organization. You ensure that materials are available when needed and that outgoing products are prepared and shipped correctly. Your responsibilities include: Packing and preparing products for shipment. Processing and preparing outgoing orders. Transporting materials and goods within the warehouse and production areas. Working with logistics systems such as SAP. Monitoring the flow of goods and reporting discrepancies. Supporting an efficient and error-free logistics process. Contributing to continuous improvements within logistics operations. This role goes beyond traditional warehouse work. You are an essential link between logistics and production, helping to ensure that materials are available at the right time and place. What skills do you have? A hands-on and proactive attitude. Accuracy and attention to detail. Motivation to learn and develop within a logistics environment. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Good communication skills in English. Previous logistics or warehouse experience is an advantage, but not required. Certificates such as EPT, forklift, or reach truck are considered a plus. What do you get in return? A gross salary of €19.17 per hour, including shift allowance. Travel allowance. A modern, clean, and high-tech working environment.

Opportunities for personal development and career growth. A dynamic and motivated international team. Long-term career opportunities within a growing organization. Holiday allowance and vacation days in accordance with Dutch regulations. You will join an international high-tech organization specializing in the development and production of advanced technologies for industries such as industrial automation, energy, and healthcare. The company combines innovation with operational excellence and offers employees a modern working environment where collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement are key. Employees are encouraged to take initiative, develop their skills, and build a long-term career within a growing international organization.
